item.title: Version 2.5
item.description:
SpeechToType 2.5

OpenAI's new speech models — including live transcription — plus a refreshed text model lineup.

New Features

  • GPT Transcribe: OpenAI's newest speech-to-text model, now the default for new installs. More accurate on short phrases, numbers, specialized terminology, and noisy audio.
  • GPT Live Transcribe: Real-time transcription over OpenAI's Realtime API — your words appear live in the overlay while you speak, and the complete, formatted text is inserted once you release the key. Just pick the model; no extra switch.
  • Recognition language: Choose the language for the new OpenAI models, or let them detect it automatically.
  • Latency setting: Tune live transcription between faster responses and higher accuracy.

Improvements

  • Better custom vocabulary: With the new OpenAI models, dictionary words are passed as dedicated keywords instead of a plain prompt, so names and domain terms are spelled correctly more often. Works in live mode too.
  • Updated text models: The rewrite model lists now offer only the current generation — GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna; Claude Opus 5, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 4.5; Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.1 Pro.

item.title: Version 2.4
item.description:
SpeechToType 2.4

Rebuilt Apple Speech live transcription and a cleaner settings layout.

Improvements

  • Apple Speech real-time: Rebuilt on Apple's modern on-device SpeechAnalyzer/SpeechTranscriber. Pauses no longer wipe what you already dictated, and long dictations are inserted reliably. Real-time is now enabled by default for Apple Speech.
  • Reorganized settings: Settings are split into a sidebar with separate areas for Speech model, Text model, Shortcuts, General, and About. Settings now open in their own window via a gear button in the bottom-left of the sidebar (and via the menu bar as before).

item.title: Version 2.3
item.description:
SpeechToType 2.3

Azure Foundry MAI, real-time live transcription, a redesigned overlay, and more control over insertion.

New Features

  • Azure Foundry MAI: New speech provider using Azure's MAI-Transcribe model (fast transcription). Configure your own endpoint, API key, and model name; custom vocabulary is passed via Azure's phraseList with an adjustable biasing weight.
  • Real-time (live) transcription: Optional live mode powered by the Azure Speech SDK — watch your words appear live in the overlay while you speak; the complete, correctly formatted text is inserted once you finish.
  • Insert without clipboard: New setting to type transcribed text directly, without ever writing to or changing the clipboard.

Improvements

  • Redesigned overlay: Bottom-centered overlay that wraps long text and grows upward dynamically instead of running off the right edge of the screen.

item.title: Version 2.2
item.description:
SpeechToType 2.2

Custom vocabulary, self-hosted authentication headers, and new models!

New Features

  • Dictionary: New sidebar tab to add custom words/spellings and general instructions that are passed to speech recognition via the prompt parameter (OpenAI and Gemini always, self-hosted Whisper and rewriting optional)
  • Simple Mode Dictionary: For self-hosted Whisper, optionally send only the words (comma-separated) without instructions
  • Custom HTTP Headers: Add custom headers for the self-hosted Whisper server and Ollama — works behind reverse proxies like Cloudflare Access

Improvements

  • New OpenAI Model: GPT-5.5 is now available for text rewriting
  • New Anthropic Models: Claude Opus 4.7 and Claude Opus 4.8 added for text rewriting

item.title: Version 2.1
item.description:
SpeechToType 2.1

Google Gemini joins the provider lineup for both speech recognition and text processing!

New Features

  • Google Gemini for Speech: Transcribe your recordings directly with Gemini's multimodal API
  • Google Gemini for Text Rewriting: Use Gemini for grammar, elaboration, translation, and custom rewrites
  • Model Selection: Choose between Gemini 3.5 Flash (fast and cost-effective) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (highest quality) — independently for speech and text
  • Shared API Key: One Gemini API key powers both speech transcription and text rewriting

Improvements

  • Renamed the "Local" speech provider to "Self-Hosted" for clarity

item.title: Version 2.0
item.description:
SpeechToType 2.0

Major update with multi-provider support for both speech recognition and text processing!

New Features

  • Multi-Provider Speech Recognition: Choose between OpenAI API, local Whisper server, or Apple Speech (on-device) for transcription
  • Apple Speech (On-Device): Use macOS built-in speech recognition — no API key or server required
  • Multi-Provider Text Processing: Choose between OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Ollama (local), or Apple Intelligence for text rewriting
  • Anthropic API Support: Use Claude models (Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6, Haiku 4.5) for text rewriting
  • Ollama Integration: Use local Ollama models for text processing — models are fetched automatically from the server
  • Apple Intelligence: Use the on-device Foundation Model for text rewriting on supported devices — no API key required
  • Separate API Keys: Optionally use a different OpenAI API key for text processing than for transcription

Improvements

  • Redesigned Settings: Unified "Speech Model Configuration" and "Text Processing" sections with provider dropdowns
  • Redesigned Onboarding: New onboarding screen lets you configure speech and text processing providers right from the start
  • Updated GPT Models: Replaced GPT-5/5.2 with GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 Mini, and GPT-5.4 Nano
  • Wider Rewrite Popup: Text rewrite popup is now wider to prevent mode tabs from being cut off
  • API key is now optional during onboarding — use local providers without any API key

item.title: Version 1.6
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.6

New default models, local Whisper server support, and UI improvements!

New Features

  • Local Whisper Server: Use your own local Whisper-compatible server instead of the OpenAI API for transcription
  • Configurable Whisper Server: Set custom server URL, model name, and optional Bearer token

Improvements

  • New Default Transcription Model: GPT-4o Transcribe is now the default (higher quality)
  • New Default Rewrite Model: GPT-5.2 is now the default for text rewriting
  • Fixed Sidebar Layout: Settings view no longer pushes the sidebar navigation off-screen on small windows
  • Scrollable detail view for better usability at any window size

item.title: Version 1.5
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.5

Major keyboard shortcut update with fully customizable shortcuts!

New Features

  • New Default Shortcut: Right Option key (⌥ rechts) is now the default for dictation instead of Control
  • Three Separate Shortcuts: Configure different shortcuts for each function:
    • Direct Dictation (hold key) - Default: Right Option
    • Continuous Recording (double-tap) - Default: Double-tap Right Option
    • Text Rewrite (key combination) - Default: Right Option + Space
  • Full Customization: Each shortcut can be set to any key or key combination
  • Improved Settings UI: Clear descriptions for each shortcut type

Improvements

  • Better modifier key detection (supports left/right variants)
  • Migration from old shortcut settings to new format
  • Updated German and English localizations

item.title: Version 1.4
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.4

Feature update with microphone selection and improved text rewriting!

New Features

  • Processing Indicator: Visual loading spinner while transcription is being processed by the API
  • Microphone Selection: Choose your preferred microphone directly from the menu bar
  • Clipboard Rewrite: New option to rewrite text from clipboard without selecting it first
  • Rewrite History: Rewritten texts are now saved to history (can be disabled in settings)
  • History Filters: Filter history by transcriptions or rewrites

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed GPT-5 and GPT-5.2 API error with max_tokens parameter
  • Improved text selection detection for rewrite function

item.title: Version 1.3
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.3

Bugfix release with improved text rewriting!

Improvements

  • Copy Button: New copy button in text rewrite popup - easily copy the result if automatic insertion doesn't work
  • Keyboard Shortcut: Use ⌘C to quickly copy the rewritten text

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed text rewrite shortcut not triggering in some cases

item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.2

Feature update with improved continuous recording and statistics!

New Features

  • Improved Continuous Recording: Double-tap Control to start continuous recording, double-tap again to stop. No need to hold the key!
  • Menu Bar Actions: Start/stop continuous recording and trigger text rewrite directly from the menu bar
  • Statistics Dashboard: Track your transcription stats - words transcribed, tokens used, and estimated time saved
  • Shortcut Reset: New button to reset keyboard shortcuts to defaults

Improvements

  • Fixed keyboard shortcut recording in settings
  • Fixed crash when holding the transcription button
  • Improved thread safety for audio level updates
  • Enhanced German and English localization

item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.1

Major feature update with new capabilities!

New Features

  • Recording Overlay: Visual indicator with sound wave animation while recording
  • Continuous Recording: Double-tap the hotkey to record without holding
  • Text Rewriting: Select text and use AI to correct grammar, elaborate, or apply custom prompts
  • Customizable Shortcuts: Configure your own keyboard shortcuts for all functions
  • GPT Model Selection: Choose between GPT-4o, GPT-5, and GPT-5.2 for text rewriting

Improvements

  • Fixed API key input in onboarding
  • Improved settings organization
  • Enhanced localization for German and English

item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
SpeechToType 1.0

First Version of SpeechToType!

  • Speech-to-text transcription using OpenAI Whisper
  • Global hotkey support
  • Menu bar integration
  • Transcription history
